name: rtc-ci-tooling-vercel
description: NOT a workspace package. Pins the Vercel CLI and its whole transitive tree under an npm lockfile (sha512 integrity) for the deploy workflows; installed by scripts/install-vercel.sh. OVERRIDES: the CLI exact-pins deps carrying known advisories (30 at 57.0.0, 29 at 59.23.1 — upstream has fixed none of them; measured 2026-09-19 that EVERY override below is still required at 59.23.1). Each lifts ONE vulnerable package to its patched line; `npm audit --package-lock-only` here must report nothing but the ONE known exception: zod 3.22.4 (GHSA-mrhx-c7xc-m3w5, `zod <4.6.6`), exact-pinned by @vercel/backends, @vercel/express, @vercel/hono and @vercel/python-analysis. zod 3 has no patched release (3.25.76 is its last), and forcing zod 4 into them swaps their validation library for a different API, so no override can lift it; the `zod@4` override covers the 4.x copy. npm counts it as 8 high, one per package that inherits it. Delete this exception when the CLI moves those builders to zod >=4.6.6. (The earlier braces exception, GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm, ended when GitHub withdrew that advisory on 2026-10-23.) After any bump, re-test each override by deleting it and re-auditing, and drop the ones upstream has caught up on. History: held on 57.x from 2026-07-28 because 58.0.0 broke `vercel pull` under env-var project linking; unpinned to 59.x once a Deploy dispatch proved `pull` works again. Evidence: docs/adr/ADR-007-ci-security-tooling.md.
